source: Project: Self v2.3 via build spec v1.1, Appendix A

rows.name: Core Gate
rows.objective: Build habits, DSA, DDIA, functional React, MEAI/MAF basics.
rows.exitEvidence: 65-80 meaningful attempts/reviews, edition-correct DDIA notes, small React app, minimal AI exercise, design doc + ADRs.

rows.name: Flagship Build
rows.objective: Build and measure a lean .NET modular monolith plus bounded applied GenAI.
rows.exitEvidence: Working vertical slices, tests, one worker, baseline evals, demo and architecture defence.

rows.name: Scale & Polish
rows.objective: Measure, deploy, observe, test and communicate the system.
rows.exitEvidence: Load report, CI/eval gate, case study and recorded mock reviews.

rows.name: Interview Sprint
rows.objective: Convert readiness into suitable applications and interviews.
rows.exitEvidence: Resume, referrals, mock feedback, funnel metrics and negotiation readiness.
